records.caption:

Fumbling for a switch in the dark on the way to the bathroom? This motion-sensing light glows softly the moment you walk by, then switches itself off. No wiring, no harsh glare, just a calm little guide through the night.

• Senses motion up to about 3 m (10 ft) at 120°, turns off after 20 seconds
• Only switches on in the dark
• Sticks on with an adhesive pad, no wiring, about 8 cm across

Link in the first comment. ¥1,980.
